items.label: OpenAI-Compatible REST API
items.value: Drop-in `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint with OpenAI schema — existing OpenAI SDKs (Python, Node, Go) work by changing only the `base_url` to `https://inference.cerebras.ai/v1` and supplying a Cerebras API key, so migration requires zero code changes.

items.label: Streaming by default
items.value: Server-sent events (SSE) and JSON stream mode both supported on every chat model; first-token latency is sub-second for Gemma 4 31B and ~200 ms for smaller Llama variants on a warm connection.

items.label: Function Calling / JSON Mode
items.value: Native tool-use on GPT-OSS 120B and Z.ai GLM 4.7; `response_format={"type":"json_schema",...}` enforced JSON output on every text-capable model; parallel tool execution supported.

items.label: Multimodal image input
items.value: Gemma 4 31B accepts base64 image inputs (PNG, JPEG, WebP up to 20 MB) directly in chat-completion messages — first-party screenshots, document scans, and diagrams without separate OCR; multimodal routing is automatic.

items.label: Inference API key scoped to single project
items.value: API keys are scoped to a per-project ID and rotate without service interruption; per-key usage telemetry surfaces in the Cerebras dashboard under a per-model breakdown.

items.label: Python SDK + LlamaIndex integration
items.value: Official `cerebras-cloud-sdk` Python package mirrors the OpenAI client surface; LlamaIndex and LangChain integrations via `ChatCerebras` adapter (in langchain-cerebras) — no glue code required for RAG pipelines.

itemsZh.label: OpenAI 兼容 REST API
itemsZh.value: 完全兼容 OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions` 端点——只需将 `base_url` 改为 `https://inference.cerebras.ai/v1` 并提供 Cerebras API Key，现有 OpenAI SDK（Python/Node/Go）即可直接调用，迁移零代码改动。

itemsZh.label: 默认流式输出
itemsZh.value: 所有对话模型都支持 SSE 与 JSON 流；Gemma 4 31B 首 token 延迟在亚秒级，小型 Llama 变体在热连接下约 200 ms。

itemsZh.label: 函数调用 / JSON 模式
itemsZh.value: GPT-OSS 120B 与 Z.ai GLM 4.7 原生支持工具调用；全部文本模型都支持 `response_format={"type":"json_schema",...}` 强制 JSON 输出；并行工具执行支持。

itemsZh.label: 多模态图像输入
itemsZh.value: Gemma 4 31B 在 chat-completion 消息中直接接受 base64 图像输入（PNG/JPEG/WebP，上限 20 MB），无需独立 OCR——可对屏幕截图、文档扫描件、示意图直接做推理。

itemsZh.label: API Key 单项目隔离
itemsZh.value: API Key 按项目 ID 隔离，可在不中断服务的前提下轮换；用量面板按模型拆分归因，便于成本归集。

itemsZh.label: Python SDK + LlamaIndex 集成
itemsZh.value: 官方 `cerebras-cloud-sdk` Python 包对齐 OpenAI client 接口；LlamaIndex 与 LangChain 通过 `ChatCerebras` 适配器接入——RAG 管线无需胶水代码。

reviewSections.title: 🎯 Wafer-Scale CS-4 Hardware & Frontier Model Catalog
reviewSections.titleZh: 🎯 晶圆级 CS-4 硬件与前沿模型目录
reviewSections.text: Cerebras Inference is one of the few platforms that runs production traffic on wafer-scale CS-4 silicon rather than merchant GPUs. The wafer's 30× speed-up at batch-1 means the inference service delivers frontier-tier latency on Llama 3.1 405B and OpenAI gpt-oss-120b at rates that traditional GPU clouds cannot match. The 2026 Q2/Q3 catalog added multimodal Gemma 4 31B (the first vision-capable Cerebras model), Z.ai GLM 4.7 for coding/reasoning, and OpenAI gpt-oss-120b under Apache-2.0 — all priced at sub-$2.50 per million output tokens. For workloads where batch-1 latency matters — interactive agents, real-time autocomplete, code completion inside an IDE, streaming chat — Cerebras is the only hosted inference platform where a 405B-class model returns the first token in under a second.
reviewSections.textZh: Cerebras Inference 是少数在生产环境使用晶圆级 CS-4 芯片（而非通用 GPU）提供推理服务的平台。晶圆在 batch-1 上 30× 的速度优势，让推理服务在 Llama 3.1 405B 和 OpenAI gpt-oss-120b 等前沿模型上达到传统 GPU 云无法匹敌的延迟。2026 年 Q2/Q3 目录新增了多模态 Gemma 4 31B（首个具备视觉能力的 Cerebras 模型）、面向编码/推理的 Z.ai GLM 4.7、以及 Apache-2.0 开源的 OpenAI gpt-oss-120b——输出 token 价格全部位于每百万 $2.50 以下。在 batch-1 延迟优先的工作负载——交互代理、实时自动补全、IDE 内代码补全、流式对话——Cerebras 是唯一能让 405B 规模模型首 token 延迟在 1 秒以内的托管推理平台。

reviewSections.title: 🌐 Regional Availability & Latency
reviewSections.text: Cerebras Inference is hosted exclusively from `inference.cerebras.ai`, served from US-based CS-4 hardware. North America customers typically see 50-200 ms TTFT on small models and ~400 ms on 405B-class models. European customers reach the US origin over trans-Atlantic fiber with TTFT roughly 1.5× the North America baseline. Asia-Pacific customers (Tokyo / Singapore / Sydney) see 600-900 ms TTFT on the same workloads — acceptable for batch pipelines but noticeable in interactive chat. Mainland China is the explicit exception: Cerebras does not currently serve inference traffic from any in-China region and outbound traffic from CN is frequently throttled by the GFW, so mainland developers should expect either 1.5 s+ TTFT or outright connection failures — a domestic provider (Zhipu, Qwen, Doubao) is the recommended fallback for user-facing applications serving CN traffic.
reviewSections.textZh: Cerebras Inference 部署在 US 区 CS-4 硬件上，统一入口 `inference.cerebras.ai`。北美客户在小模型上典型 TTFT 50-200 ms，405B 规模模型约 400 ms。欧洲客户跨大西洋访问，TTFT 大约是北美的 1.5 倍。亚太（东京/新加坡/悉尼）客户访问同样负载 TTFT 600-900 ms——批处理流水线可接受，交互对话会有明显感知。中国大陆是明确例外：Cerebras 目前没有中国大陆推理区，CN 出向流量常被 GFW 限速，因此大陆开发者要么承受 1.5 s 以上的 TTFT，要么频繁遇到连接失败——面向 C 端用户的应用建议回退到国内厂商（智谱、通义、豆包）。
